solutions.title: Collect, sort, and rebuild
solutions.strategy: Read all node values, sort them, and build a new sorted output chain.

timeComplexity.explanation: Collecting values is O(n), sorting all values dominates at O(n log n), and rebuilding the output chain is O(n).

spaceComplexity.explanation: The values array and rebuilt output list store all n values.

solutions.title: Min heap of current list heads
solutions.strategy: Keep the smallest current node from each non-empty list in a heap, repeatedly appending the minimum and pushing its successor.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of n nodes is pushed and popped at most once, and the heap holds at most k list heads.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap stores at most one active node per input list, excluding the returned chain.
